title: Valar Atomics footer
description: A black footer about a window tall: a giant extra-wide caps call on the left, big mono link rows with thin arrows on the right, then small links spread across a row, an outlined pill and icons, dim legal lines, and a large glowing brand mark centred underneath. It sits sticky at the bottom so the page slides away to uncover it, and the mark fades in over the last stretch of scroll.
notes: the uncover effect needs the page's main to be `relative z-10` with a background, and the footer as its next sibling
always black (a `dark` scope); the empty mark slot is a radial glow in the theme's --glow (white here)
the mark fade is a CSS scroll timeline on the page scroll (no JS)
